honesty_contract: The CI resolve step (tests/simulation/lib/journey-selection.mjs) enforces a registry bijection: every registered scenario is exactly one of selected (proven) or an explicit not_runnable ledger entry with a specific reason. Unknown ids, duplicates, an empty selection, and non-importable scenarios fail the lane before execution. Scenarios in the registry's releaseObligationIds (82/83/84) are named individually as pending credential-free release obligations — never hidden behind a generic 'not yet proven' reason. Registered scenarios absent from smoke+extra are recorded in the uploaded ui-journeys artifact on every full run — never silently skipped, never counted as passes (D.8).
